Repo-local native allocation hooks

Pinned upstream packages: regex 1.13.1, regex-automata 0.4.18, regex-syntax 0.8.11 (MIT OR Apache-2.0), fancy-regex 0.14.0 (MIT). Original package licenses and copyright notices are preserved. upstream-source-manifest.json binds the actual local upstream inputs. No global Cargo registry files are modified.

The opt-in native-admission feature adds checked entries for the existing AST/HIR, forward Thompson/Pike and Fancy parser/compiler/VM algorithms. Original constructors and their default paths stay available. Checked programs retain no lender or search scratch; the compiler host supplies its same source-family loan through the existing session Db. Captures copied into fixture results are admitted on the existing fixture owner before the scratch loan ends.

These are source drafts, not typechecked or executed. Existing generic query-graph/allocator metadata policy is unchanged and is not an exact heap/RSS guarantee. The legacy/container-only API intentionally retains its prior unqualified regex implementation; the ordinary native selftest host selects the explicit actual-provider API. Ordinary source-policy scan lender threading is a separate remaining port and no default or whole-policy heap qualification is claimed.
